name: Lightning
description: WebGL2 shader background that renders animated lightning bolts with branches, glow and flicker. Bolts lean toward the pointer, and clicking fires a strike from the click point down to the top.
contents: Single full-size canvas rendering 1 to 4 procedural lightning bolts with side branches
behavior: Bolts drift and flicker continuously, with an intro reveal that sweeps in from the top
Pointer inside the page bends nearby bolts and heats them with extra brightness and branches
Click or tap fires a temporary strike with a flash, up to 4 at once
Rendering pauses when the canvas is off screen or the tab is hidden
Reduced motion preference disables animation, flicker, pointer and click effects
Light mode draws dark ink-like bolts for light backgrounds
editableByProps: Bolt color, count (1 to 4), spacing, horizontal offset and rotation angle
Bolt size, thickness, glow, intensity, branch amount and flicker
Animation speed, pause, intro reveal and edge fade
Pointer interaction, its strength, and click strikes
Overall opacity, light mode for light backgrounds, pixel ratio cap, className and inline style

needsCodeEdit.change: Allow more than 4 simultaneous bolts or click strikes
Change how long click strikes last
Change bolt shape or branch logic
needsCodeEdit.where: bolt function in the FRAGMENT shader

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing when unavailable
Canvas fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height and should be positioned as a background layer
Pointer and click listeners are on window, so interaction works even when content sits above the canvas
Strike count is limited to 4 and bolt count to 4
Responsive through ResizeObserver, works on mobile, but the heavy shader may be slow on low-end phones
